        if row["timeseries_id"]==tid:
            vals[row["timestamp"]]=float(row["value"])
d1=[v for ts,v in vals.items() if ts.startswith("2018-07-24")]
d2=[v for ts,v in vals.items() if ts.startswith("2018-01-17")]
print(len(d1),len(d2))
m1=sum(d1)/len(d1); m2=sum(d2)/len(d2)
